newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bus driver shot because he missed stop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bus driver shot because he missed stop.

text.p: A bus passenger shot dead the driver because he missed his stop on Friday, a police spokesman said.
He said Osmi Menezes Moreira, 24, went up to driver Jose Hermogeno, 62, and shot him in the chest after he drove past the stop at which Moreira wanted to get off.
Moreira was arrested after trying to escape and shooting at police officers, the spokesman said.
